title: Grade 4-6
cookbook_title: Bathe, buff, and beautify : DIY crafts and recipes for natural body care
description:
48 pages : 26 cm

"Nourish your body from head to toe with these simple handmade spa recipes. Using some of nature's best ingredients, such as sea salt, honey, essential oils, and beeswax, you'll craft soothing recipes like the Luxurious Lotion Bars, Sweet Dreams Cream, and the Good Morning Shower Steamer. Soak in invigorating Peppermint Bath Salts, exfoliate with your very own homemade shower puff, and then hydrate with a handcrafted Cinnamon Vanilla Whipped Body Butter. Experience a natural beauty routine with these fresh, fun spa projects."--Back cover
